### 💥 BREAKING CHANGES
- due to [`ea9f2b2`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/ea9f2b22cf5ba32b18ffb1a96d3b9dd555f1338b) - Update minimum Android version to 7.0, update dependencies *(commit by @aliernfrog)*:

  PF Tool now requires at least Android 7.0 due to new AndroidX dependency requirements


### ✨ New Features
- [`beac9c4`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/beac9c4999677426aaddd1cd15c4f566bd056ab6) - **Shizuku**: Recommend thedjchi fork and support its hiding feature *(PR #110 by @aliernfrog)*
- [`092f78e`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/092f78e7b0453fc0985b75ac5b52b7ae8fd04281) - Improve Issues & Feedback section in About page, improve expandable row *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`ea9f2b2`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/ea9f2b22cf5ba32b18ffb1a96d3b9dd555f1338b) - Update minimum Android version to 7.0, update dependencies *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`42c3258`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/42c3258d390f3f7bd6d5ed191696b17c42e357e3) - **Crash handler**: Ability to leave a message for crash reports *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`95b4e28`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/95b4e2849844203f317b337cdaf175e7b3eda8d5) - **Maps**: Improve search bar and move style button out of it *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`b196f3d`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/b196f3d275351d614b0db071ddb1c1a60b1a6cca) - **Maps**: Ability to download maps from URL *(PR #114 by @aliernfrog)*
- [`8841f65`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/8841f656960c5e42790c34478a273c3838850943) - Opt-in blur effects, draw content behind keyboard *(PR #116 by @aliernfrog)*
- [`0eb33df`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/0eb33df072bc251a0ef0447beaf37c54414e917a) - **Maps**: Show thumbnail for unimported maps, refresh list style options UI *(PR #117 by @aliernfrog)*
- [`77088bb`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/77088bb3063e919466d239c8dc77aa31b0d85c1d) - **l10n**: Update translations *(PR #111 by @aliernfrog)*

### 🐛 Bug Fixes
- [`1fc5461`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/1fc5461a1628a1d48691d5db66a7af8a2cf119cd) - Add extra spacing to bottom of pages to improve visibility *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`2d8b0db`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/2d8b0db8f3940d394769ba4ce118fcc0cde64709) - Correctly handle new intents *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`c720cb7`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/c720cb758d053a204062d346b0a5440dc600e083) - **Crash details sheet**: Prevent sheet from re-opening on configuration change *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`e1976ba`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/e1976ba54fa56d4c5ecaf2f6678a1e8841dd29d9) - **Progress dialog**: Janky cancel button animation *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`c253223`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/c2532231d26c997feb8f6224f871263cef646318) - **Maps list**: Fix various issues caused by separation of FAB *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`470b9de`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/470b9de7c8e4993b118bdda1fb9224116d021fab) - **Shizuku**: Do not show warning when using other forks, add link to forks list *(commit by @aliernfrog)*

### ♻️ Refactors
- [`f03f561`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/f03f561d1a32d9301a4d7814960c21feb40289fe) - Update file sharing for upcoming Android changes *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`77608fa`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/77608fa97a7a06fcac541efc59bbd6d295792118) - **Fading edge**: Automatically match background and determine RTL status *(commit by @aliernfrog)*

### 🐛 Bug Fixes
- [`230924a`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/230924aa78844546ee3a870a210e3e7b764ea0e1) - **Updates**: Remove misleading incompatible version warning *(commit by @aliernfrog)*

### ✨ New Features
- [`2847bea`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/2847bea043ff231e5f04c5829fdd41743f767b9a) - Improve and update credits *(PR #106 by @aliernfrog)*

### 🐛 Bug Fixes
- [`f98322c`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/f98322cc1f7ea75ead5693615cef0e53b90bfd3f) - **SAF**: Catch errors when checking for URI permissions *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`d1d3cf2`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/d1d3cf2c39df3ac6dc6966a5894eac6ad1cee39a) - Handle DocumentsUI being disabled/uninstalled *(PR #107 by @aliernfrog)*

### ♻️ Refactors
- [`29dbf00`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/29dbf00b0b830d1d9cbe15f5b1e113a3b9f50621) - **Shared strings**: Data class based resolving instead of key lookup *(PR #102 by @aliernfrog)*

### ✨ New Features
- [`dd96e97`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/dd96e97c04cd91c489cb7ab5c89e7d924222d70f) - **Media overlay**: Toolbar animation and elevation, adapt system bars to light theme *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`c5c5006`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/c5c5006cee7d9deae4da39e4d3957332e878d29d) - UI improvements here and there *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`c290e05`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/c290e05dff3a66a6ce8cbe7a37f1ba16da0b43b8) - **Updates screen**: UI improvements *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`edd4fd7`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/edd4fd746410ddcf4e49e31e4c241b0a0016a9f4) - Ability to report caught errors *(PR #99 by @aliernfrog)*
- [`37167e8`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/37167e82d0db41fb32aca4a7d5b1c5c4141aa624) - **Maps list**: Separate pager and header *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`21e775d`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/21e775d6ed3895210bf544f9e99320a0c2322340) - Improve toast contrast and animations *(commit by @aliernfrog)*

### 🐛 Bug Fixes
- [`c682b4e`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/c682b4ef6372de4698399f1e075cd4fc5f897d63) - **Permissions**: Check if given path is a directory *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`637710d`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/637710dddfd811fd1d343f097d89bce05c1698a6) - **Updates screen**: Use latest release info, add missing elevation to toolbar *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`c57f634`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/c57f6344a5b060f795fa98a5fe776b6cbb9f1a64) - **Updates**: Restore update badge on settings button *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`bfb4a76`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/bfb4a768d5c9882892e3a41775007adc495b48f3) - **Maps**: Avoid duplicating navigation entry *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`6a81339`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/6a8133995ab8eefee3e4e853a97b192147b1f203) - **Updates screen**: Do not show open in browser label if not enough space *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`30a2c08`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/30a2c0878365bfc1104f396cd70c39aa90cfb677) - **FAB**: Adjust label visibility animation *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`7416e6f`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/7416e6fb787dfded3b967a978f32459508505327) - **Maps list**: Use full item span for grid view segment summary *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`db728bf`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/db728bf943bc9130c9e3d8f257f2708212d76282) - **Maps list**: Always show select/deselect all option when multi-selecting *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`f21743b`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/f21743bfc5683be228173c9006aaecd907ca0321) - **Maps**: Do not show thumbnail share option when no thumbnail file *(commit by @aliernfrog)*

### ♻️ Refactors
- [`0656f1d`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/0656f1d58b235c85670a3547350495082d9ee3b3) - Correct ViewModel handling by using domains and `viewModelOf` *(PR #98 by @aliernfrog)*

### 🐛 Bug Fixes
- [`62c64f5`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/62c64f53731a65794f1dd265f312d5a069bd95c0) - **Maps**: Prevent crash when maps folder is not a directory, inform the user instead *(commit by @aliernfrog)*

# Note
This release includes major refactors to improve state management and move shared code across my apps to reusable modules/libraries. Issues are expected, you can report them on [Issues](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/issues) or on [Discord](https://aliernfrog.github.io/discord).

### ✨ New Features
- [`4fc7dc9`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/4fc7dc969b922361168d570acaa8cf6b8fe54118) - **Maps**: Use toolbar for thumbnail viewer instead of bottom sheet *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`924ce21`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/924ce214a7815ef9950248f299c96b94abde3bf4) - Redesign update flow and API with `minSdk` checks *(PR #90 by @aliernfrog)*
- [`0ec623c`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/0ec623cc72237a1685cfe4ff9b7503f59918097e) - Add crash handler and support links *(PR #91 by @aliernfrog)*
- [`6dcb24f`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/6dcb24fe5820a75c08ba966444c104713b53d278) - Add tooltips to all icon buttons *(PR #92 by @aliernfrog)*
- [`75c6d5a`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/75c6d5adff31a93908c2721a4e735342c34061b1) - **l10n**: Update translations *(PR #88 by @aliernfrog)*

### 🐛 Bug Fixes
- [`dd8203a`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/dd8203a304b694d07bfcb488b52bc2b5ca44e1c1) - **SharedString**: Update resource id based on state *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`55c5a14`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/55c5a14d349edd6171385b61fe261c999ce30474) - **MapsListScreen**: Allow specifying file mime type *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`74269a1`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/74269a14544be42356db72466972c9643a49d748) - **`FileWrapper/createFile`**: `findFile` after `createFile` for DocumentFileCompat *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`c67f444`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/c67f4449f19b3b677396b7a34d7d75a9f9708efa) - **Shizuku**: Improve reliability when exporting maps and copying files *(commit by @aliernfrog)*

### ♻️ Refactors
- [`24054d3`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/pf-tool/commit/24054d3ab949d4c79f4848d122976589408ac80a) - Move shared code to separate modules *(PR #86 by @aliernfrog)*
